pages.page_lead: Photographs from a 1987 Oakland celebration honoring Ronald V. Dellums’s first twenty years in elected public service.
history_paragraphs: Ronald V. Dellums began his elected career on the Berkeley City Council in 1967 and entered the U.S. House of Representatives in January 1971. He became known for his opposition to the Vietnam War and military spending, his advocacy for civil rights, and his work against apartheid in South Africa. For additional context, see the U.S. House of Representatives’ historical biography.

On May 31, 1987, supporters and guests gathered at Oakland’s Hyatt Regency Hotel to celebrate twenty years since Dellums first took elected office. Photographs preserved with the celebration show speeches, musical performances, portraits of guests, and the presentation of a commemorative plaque.

pages.page_lead: Photographs of people gathered outdoors near a brick building, provisionally associated with political activity.
history_paragraphs: The photographs show people talking and posing together, preparing food, and sitting in an outdoor audience near a brick building. Some participants hold papers, while others appear to wear buttons. Group portraits, conversations, and views of the surrounding building place the people in the setting of a larger gathering.
The collection steward considers these scenes likely to be associated with political activity. The specific occasion, organizers, participants, date, and location have not been established.

pages.page_lead: Photographs of a community ball game, its players, and the people gathered to watch.
history_paragraphs: At an outdoor ball field, players take turns at bat as a catcher and other participants gather nearby. Spectators watch from beyond the fence, and the photographs capture both the action of the game and the interactions around it. The date, location, and identities of the participants have not been established.

pages.page_lead: Mounted riders proceeding along a city street, with onlookers beside the route.
history_paragraphs: Mounted riders wearing western attire proceed along a paved city street as people watch. The occasion, participants, date, and exact location remain under research.

pages.page_lead: Close portraits centered on expression, gesture, and composition.
history_paragraphs: Portraiture brings attention to the person photographed. In these photographs, framing, expression, and gesture take precedence over the surrounding setting. The identities, dates, and locations of individual portraits remain under research.
